column1: # Machine-readable half of the skills-resync inventory: what each vendored skill was
# copied from, and the upstream commit it was copied at.
# No version directory appears here on purpose. resync.sh resolves the plugin root from
# installed_plugins.json's installPath, which the plugin manager keeps current, so a plugin
# update moves the path and the script follows it.
# The baseline column is rewritten by `resync.sh --apply` on every successful re-vendor.
# Do not hand-edit it: a baseline that lags reports upstream as moved when it has not.
# SKILL.md is the source of truth for *why* a row is here and which protected edits it
# carries. This file is the source of truth for *where* it came from.
